abilities.name: magnet-pull
abilities.effect: Prevents steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.

abilities.name: sturdy
abilities.effect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead.  Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

abilities.name: analytic
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.

kanto.flavorText: Formed by several MAGNEMITE linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

original-johto.flavorText: When many MAGNETON gather together, the resulting magnetic storm disrupts radio waves.

hoenn.flavorText: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.

updated-johto.flavorText: The MAGNEMITE are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.

original-unova.flavorText: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.

updated-unova.flavorText: The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.

kalos.flavorText: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Magneton emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to electronics and precision instruments. Because of this, it is said that some towns warn people to keep this Pokémon inside a Poké Ball.

original-alola.flavorText: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

updated-alola.flavorText: When rain clouds form, many Magneton gather in high places to wait for lightning to strike.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.

swsh.flavorText: This Pokémon is constantly putting out a powerful magnetic force. Most computers go haywire when a Magneton approaches.

pla.flavorText: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.
